author: AbusiveUser
body:
Hello Abusive here!
Well I came with an idea of how to improve the official streamings. The Invitationals week are coming and I saw a stream and to be honest I didn't like the streaming, so I came with an idea of how to improve those future streamings that need some help.
So, let's start!
PD: take in mind that this topic was made with the only purpose of having better streams with more quality with my opinions.

Improve screen overlays.
I saw the last streaming and to be honest, it was horrible. Just color boxes with a text white are not the best thing to make an stream.
To prevent this, I made a new Overlay that medias can use in their streamings, is more beautiful and and more understandable to the new people and you can edit this faster.

New Screen Overlay contains:
  • Avicus Logo
  • Streamer Name
  • Server IP
  • Event Name
  • Team Names 
Here's a screenshot of it:

PD: Some of this ideas were taken from other streamings.

Streamer Texture Packs.
I thought on this idea because using the default pack with hearts are not good for the stream viewers and it can be bored, so I made a texture pack that make the GUI invisible (such as hotbar, compass, hearts, etc...) to make the stream better and without F1.

Here's a screenshot about the texture pack:


PD: This pack will be only given to Media Staff, you can add fullbright texture pack if you want

Better concentration when making a stream.
This is very important for making a stream, you need to be prepared to prevent only making parkour when the game is running (this is obviously wrong because the viewers will leave because they can't see the match)

So, I made a few list of thing that can make you better at those streams:
  • Having a clear idea of ​​what are you going to say
  • Add emotion when you speak (like adding emotion when they are pushing)
  • Never miss the excitement 
  • Add songs to make a good atmosphere
  • Colaborations with other Media Staff

 Here are some opinions about how to improve a stream with my opinions, if you have any question about this just ask it in the comments
 and I will try my best to answer quickly. And if a streamer is interested on having the Screen Overlay and the Texture hit me at TeamSpeak or at my skype 'uhmbrokennz'
Sorry if I have some grammar problems, If I do just tell me and I will fix them.

If you have any suggestion just comment below, hates and agreements are good.
